test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 24 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Six doctors, K, L, M, N, O and P, are sitting in a straight line. All are facing the north direction. Only O is sitting between N and L. Only P is sitting between L and K. K sits fifth to the right of M. Who is sitting to the immediate right of M?
solution:
According to the given information,

1) K sits fifth to the right of M.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c6e556234da5d43c9acef4729d9f5b4e1c6913ce5fea9c45426d0c74b1125e5d.png] 

2) Only P is sitting between L and K.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bda032e1afa7257ad20d46a162ce4b8f43a36062d88283e540022b739d6a08ec.png] 

3) Only O is sitting between N and L.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/57bdc0b32869f8bcc2c76feb80ea5c20c00cc8655b5e5974716b788f56e3a004.png] 

Here, we can see that N is sitting to the immediate right of M.

Hence, the correct answer is **"N"**.
